text:
The latest round of European action brings another batch of clashes where the model spots intriguing differences against Bet365. While the bookmaker continues to hold a slim edge over the long run, several overlooked sides stand out as worth a closer look this weekend.

The most striking divergence comes in Serie A, where the model hands Cagliari a 27.5% chance to win at Lazio compared to the 13.3% implied by Bet365's 7.5 odds, while also seeing a draw as a 31.6% possibility. In La Liga, the model gives Santander a 19.3% shot at shocking Real Madrid at odds of 10.0, compared to Bet365's 10.0%, and rates a stalemate at 25.2%. Another notable contrast appears in Frosinone v Torino, where the model actually makes Torino favourites with a 49.7% chance to win at odds of 3.1, well above Bet365's 32.3%.

Reflecting on the played rounds, the model enjoyed standout moments alongside inevitable surprises. In the Premier League, it handled Aston Villa's 2-1 win over Manchester City far better than Bet365, recording a lower log loss of 1.251 to 1.657, and was decisive in calling Fulham's away win at Coventry. Serie A was a high point for the model, virtually banking on Inter's win at Venezia with a 91.5% probability and strongly anticipating Napoli's victory at Monza. However, shock away wins—such as Real Madrid taking El Clasico at Barcelona and Borussia Monchengladbach stunning Stuttgart 3-2—left both the model and the bookmaker badly wrong-footed.
